title: tpm2-tools 2b owes: output caps for tpm2_create and tpm2_createprimary (#301 round 2 new 8)
description: The 4096-byte output cap is sized for tpm2_unseal (32 bytes). tpm2_createprimary and tpm2_create print the public area as YAML (an RSA2048 modulus alone is 512 hex characters) and verbose TSS2 logging on stderr can pass the cap, so a real failure would read as tool_output_too_large instead of tool_failed. Slice 2b passes -Q where it applies or measures the real output on jetson (no binary goes to jetson before slice 4: use a measurement the operator runs), and treats stderr as diagnostic: truncate rather than refuse.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each tool the adapter runs has a cap justified by its measured or documented output, and a failure with verbose stderr is reported as tool_failed, not tool_output_too_large

implementationNotes: Partly met by #316 (e2093dd): -Q on tpm2_createprimary and tpm2_create, stderr truncated to the cap and drained, and a noisy failing tool is tool_failed (tested), so the verbose-stderr clause holds. NOT met: the first clause (each tool cap justified by measured or documented output) needs the real-output measurement, an operator run on jetson; no binary goes there before slice 4. The task stays To Do for that measurement and for the unseal tools (tpm2_load, startauthsession, sessionconfig, unseal).
